fullDesc: In August 1521 Hernán Cortés and his Spanish forces, with thousands of Indigenous allies, took the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan after a long siege. Disease, especially smallpox, devastated the city's defenders.
realFacts: Mexico City was built on the ruins
Smallpox killed a large share of the population
Indigenous allies such as the Tlaxcalans were crucial
New Spain was ruled for about 300 years
